risks.title: Healthcare Cost Management
risks.score_rationale: Healthcare costs are critical to profitability. The 10-K explicitly states that numerous factors affecting healthcare costs may adversely affect the company's ability to predict and manage such costs, including changes in healthcare practices, utilization patterns, demographic characteristics, medical cost inflation, and increased labor costs. This directly impacts the company's cash flows and financial condition. Citation: "This segment benefits from working with our Carelon businesses, which support medical and pharmacy cost". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company is exposed to risks related to healthcare cost management. Failure to appropriately predict and price for healthcare costs could adversely affect profitability and financial results.

risks.title: Cybersécurité
risks.score_rationale: As a health insurer handling sensitive member data, the company faces material cybersecurity risks. Data breaches could compromise member privacy, result in regulatory penalties, and damage reputation, all of which could negatively impact operations and financial condition. Citation: "Key drivers impacting the results of operations for our Health Benefits segment include membership levels". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks that could compromise sensitive member data and result in operational and financial losses.

risks.title: Risque réglementaire et de conformité
risks.score_rationale: The company operates under strict healthcare regulations including data protection and privacy requirements. Regulatory changes could increase operational costs and complexity. The 10-K mentions the company's compliance with applicable regulations and the potential for regulatory changes to impact operations. Citation: "Key drivers impacting the results of operations for our Health Benefits segment include membership levels". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company is subject to strict healthcare and data protection regulations that could change and increase operational burden.

risks.title: Competitive Pressure
risks.score_rationale: The health insurance market is competitive, with customers able to switch providers based on pricing and service quality. The company must maintain competitive advantage through differentiated offerings and operational efficiency. Citation: "Carelon Carelon integrates physical, behavioral, social and pharmacy services to deliver whole health affordably by". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company operates in a competitive market where pricing and service quality are key differentiators for customer retention.

risks.title: Government Program Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company generates significant revenue from government programs including Medicaid and Medicare. Changes in government reimbursement rates or program policies could materially impact revenue and profitability. Citation: "Through our participation in various federal government programs, we generated approximately 32%, 31% and 29%". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company is exposed to risks from dependence on government programs, where policy changes could negatively impact financial results.

company_description: Elevance Health, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a health benefits company in the United States. The company operates in four segments: Health Benefits, CarelonRx, Carelon Services, and Corporate & Other. It offers a variety of health plans and services to individual, employer group risk-based and fee-based, BlueCard, Medicare, Medicaid, and FEP members; health products; a broad array of fee-based administrative managed care services; and specialty and other insurance products and services, such as stop loss, dental, vision, and supplemental health insurance benefits. The company also operates in the pharmacy services business; and markets and offers pharmacy services, including home delivery and specialty pharmacies, claims adjudication, formulary management, pharmacy networks, rebate administration, a prescription drug database, and member services, as well as infusion services and injectable therapies through ambulatory infusion centers. In addition, it provides healthcare related services and capabilities, including specialty care enablement and utilization management support for specialized clinical domains; behavioral health and comprehensive care management

fr.activity: Elevance Health améliore la santé des gens en proposant des solutions d'assurance et de soins de santé complètes.

fr.positioning: Elevance Health est un acteur majeur de l'assurance maladie aux États-Unis, se positionnant comme un 'payer-provider' intégré, distinct des assureurs traditionnels comme UnitedHealth Group ou Anthem (son ancien nom).

fr.moat: Son avantage concurrentiel repose sur une large base d'adhésents, une intégration verticale progressive des services de santé via Carelon, et des contrats pluriannuels avec les employeurs et les gouvernements.
fr.risks: Les risques incluent la dépendance aux cycles réglementaires de la santé aux États-Unis et la pression croissante des coûts médicaux sur les marges d'assurance.
